candidates: When adding an entry to `.lintstagedrc.mjs` that invokes a code-generation script, verify that the script name exactly matches the corresponding key in `package.json` `scripts`, and include any flags the script needs to stage its own output (e.g. `--git` so the script runs `git add` on the files it generates).

In Vite plugin `transform` functions (and similar handlers), use early returns / guard clauses rather than nesting the main logic inside `if/else` blocks. For example, `if (!id.endsWith('schema.yaml')) { return; }` at the top of the function, then continue at the outermost indentation level without a wrapping else.

All properties in Mermaid diagram-config TypeScript interfaces (e.g. `FlowchartDiagramConfig`, `QuadrantChartConfig`) must be optional (`?`). Since `MermaidConfig` is consumed as a partial user input, no sub-config property should appear in a `required` array in `src/schemas/config.schema.yaml`; defaults belong in the schema's `default` fields or in `defaultConfig.ts`.
Scripts placed in `packages/mermaid/scripts/` should use the `.mts` extension rather than `.mjs` so that TypeScript type-checking applies to the scripts themselves.

Do not merge temporary files created solely to assist PR review (e.g. an `oldDefaultConfig.ts` left for side-by-side comparison). Remove such files before merging, or in an immediate follow-up cleanup commit.
All `import` statements in TypeScript/JavaScript modules must appear at the top of the file. Mid-file or function-level static imports should be moved to the top-level import section.
